title: Set 310

sentences.ko: 택배가 멤피스에서 벌써 나흘째 멈춰 있어. 근데 어디 전화해서 물어볼 데도 없어. 홈페이지에 있는 거라곤 챗봇 하나뿐인데, 그게 계속 똑같은 링크만 보내.
sentences.text: My package has been stuck in Memphis for four days now, and I can't even call anyone about it, because the only thing on their website is a chatbot that keeps sending me the same link.

alts.text: It's been four days and my package is still stuck in Memphis. I can't even call anybody, since their site's just a chatbot that keeps sending me the same link.
For four days now, my package has been held in Memphis, and I am unable to contact anyone about it, as the only option on their website is a chatbot that repeatedly sends me the same link.

sentences.note: **stuck** 은 어딘가에 걸려서 꼼짝 못 하는 상태예요. 택배나 차가 안 움직일 때 자주 써요. **for four days now** 처럼 now 를 붙이면 벌써 그만큼 됐다는 답답함이 묻어나요.

sentences.ko: 내가 뭘 고르기만 하면 넌 그거 볼 기분 아니라고 하잖아. 그러니까 그냥 네가 골라. 또 그 실화 범죄물이어도 절대 불평 안 할게.
sentences.text: Every time I pick something, you say you're not in the mood for it. So why don't you just pick, and I promise I won't complain, even if it's another one of those true crime shows.

alts.text: Whatever I pick, you're not in the mood. So you pick, and I swear I won't complain, even if it's another one of those true crime shows.
Each time I make a choice, you tell me you are not in the mood for it. Perhaps you could choose instead, and I promise I will not complain, even if it is another one of those true crime programs.

sentences.note: **not in the mood for** 는 지금 그걸 할 기분이 아니라는 뜻이에요. **why don't you just** 는 그냥 네가 ~하지 그래, 하고 가볍게 권하는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 애가 저녁 내내 멀쩡하더니, 내가 불을 끄자마자 갑자기 배고파 죽겠대. 그래서 결국 밤 10시에 토스트를 해 줬는데, 이젠 내가 너무 말똥말똥해서 잠이 안 와.
sentences.text: He was fine all evening, and then the second I turned off the light, he decided he was starving. So I ended up making him toast at ten o'clock, and now I'm too wired to fall asleep myself.

alts.text: All evening he's totally fine, then the second I turn off the light, suddenly he's starving. So I end up making him toast at ten o'clock, and now I'm way too wired to sleep myself.

He was perfectly fine throughout the evening, but the moment I turned off the light, he decided that he was starving. I ended up making him toast at ten o'clock, and now I am far too alert to fall asleep myself.

sentences.note: **the second I** 는 내가 ~하자마자라는 뜻이에요. **wired** 는 피곤한데도 신경이 곤두서서 잠이 안 오는 상태를 말해요.

sentences.ko: 고양이가 이 소파 팔걸이를 다 뜯어 놔서 새 소파를 사야 하긴 하는데, 솔직히 새 걸 사도 또 똑같이 뜯어 놓을 거면 무슨 소용인가 싶어.
sentences.text: We need a new couch because the cat's ripped up the arm on this one, but honestly, I don't see the point if she's just going to do the same thing to the new one.

alts.text: The cat's ripped up the arm on this couch, so we kinda need a new one, but honestly, what's the point if she's just gonna do the same thing to the next one?
We need to replace the couch, because the cat has torn the arm on this one. Frankly, however, I do not see the point if she is simply going to do the same thing to the new one.

sentences.note: **ripped up** 은 찢어서 너덜너덜하게 만들었다는 뜻이에요. **I don't see the point** 는 그래 봐야 무슨 소용이 있나 싶다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 월요일에 누가 회사에 도넛을 사 오기 전까지는 다이어트 진짜 잘하고 있었어. 하나 먹고 나서, 어차피 오늘은 망쳤으니까 다음 주부터 다시 시작하는 게 낫겠다 싶었지. 근데 지난주에도 똑같은 소리를 했거든. 그러니 나도 모르겠어.
sentences.text: I was doing really well on my diet until somebody brought donuts into work on Monday. I had one, and then I figured since I'd already messed up the day, I might as well start over next week. But I said the exact same thing last week, so I don't know.

alts.text: My diet was going great till someone brought donuts to work Monday. I had one, then figured the day's already blown, so might as well start over next week. But I said the exact same thing last week, so I dunno.

I had been doing very well with my diet until someone brought donuts to the office on Monday. I had one, and then I decided that since I had already ruined the day, I might as well begin again next week. However, I said exactly the same thing last week, so I am not certain.

sentences.note: **messed up** 은 일을 망쳤다는 뜻이에요. **might as well** 은 어차피 이렇게 된 거 ~하는 게 낫겠다는 느낌이에요. **start over** 는 처음부터 다시 시작한다는 말이에요.

reviewed: 2번 한국어 '그 실화 범죄 프로 중 하나여도' 가 번역투라 '또 그 실화 범죄물이어도' 로 자연스럽게 고침
3번 한국어 '걔가' 는 아이 얘기에 어색해서 '애가' 로 고침
5번 한국어 끝맺음 '그러니까 모르겠다' 가 어색해서 '그러니 나도 모르겠어' 로 고침
